dogecoin.text:
@thasaucebauce That would make Dogecoin a useful for medium exchanging/processing payments and Bitcoin useful for a store of value.

To say these two have a similar investment thesis is objectively false.

@thasaucebauce Dogecoin is inflationary with an unlimited supply. Bitcoin is deflationary as it has a capped supply.

Dogecoin has fast transaction speeds and Bitcoin has slow speeds due to the fact that its harder to confirm on the network.
